variants.name: Purr
variants.desc: Eyes closed, slow deep breaths and a soft purr.

variants.name: Doze
variants.desc: Nods off with little moons floating up.

variants.name: Hum
variants.desc: Sways to itself, humming notes into the air.

variants.name: Float
variants.desc: Drifts gently up and down above its own shadow.

variants.name: Bask
variants.desc: Settles in the sun, relaxed and a little rosy.
